records.text: Laura Loomer alleged Candace Owens, Nick Fuentes, David Axelrod, and Aubrey Laitsch converged in Rome for a secret anti-Trump summit and suggested it was funded by foreign money connected to Qatar
records.speaker: Laura Loomer

appearances.snippet: For a secret anti-Trump summit just days after Barack Hussein Obama's top advisor, David Axelrod, met with the Pope, Candace Owens, Nick Fuentes, and the alleged fire Turning Point USA leaker, Aubrey Laitsch, all suddenly appeared in Rome. ... A reliable source informed me that Aubrey (Aubrey Laitsch) approached several conservatives last year in an effort to recruit them to attend a paid propaganda trip to Qatar. ... I have suspicion it is all being funded by foreign dark money.

verification.notes: The source episode reads Loomers post in full, including the alleged Rome convergence of Owens, Fuentes, Axelrod, and Laitsch and her suspicion of Qatar-linked foreign funding. This verifies that Loomer made the accusation; searches found no evidence establishing a secret summit or foreign funding.

records.text: Candace Owens denied meeting Aubrey Laitsch, Nick Fuentes, or David Axelrod in Rome and said she traveled there with her husband and children for a planned family trip
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So the reality, just to clarify for everyone, is that I went to Rome with my husband and my children who I am not living separately from. ... But it was a planned trip to Rome ... I did not see Aubrey (Aubrey Laitsch) I did not see Nick Fuentes I did not see David Axelrod

verification.notes: Independent reporting and a Catholic organization confirm Owens was in Rome for her Traditional Latin Rite confirmation, and public material shows she traveled with family. The no-meetings denial and characterization of the whole trip as planned family travel are not independently provable, so only the Rome/family-purpose portion is supported.

records.text: Candace Owens said she was confirmed in the Catholic Church in Rome using the old Latin rite by a cardinal, with her London priest present
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I was confirmed by in the old Latin rite by a cardinal. My priest flew in from London.

verification.notes: Catholics for Catholics independently reports that Owens received Confirmation in the Traditional Latin Rite in Rome during the relevant week. The available independent report does not identify the cardinal or confirm that her London priest attended, so those details remain supported only by Owens own statement.
